page.layout: Running head and page number at top; one block of italic verse, indented lines, with a ruled line below it; centred spaced-capital heading "SECUNDA PARS."; then one block of italic verse running to the foot of the page with a drop cap S; catchword "D" at the lower right. No margin text.

p.i: Non lactis ullo tempore largior Illis caprarum copia defuit Boumque: non agni, nec hœdi Nec Basana regione pasti Greges bidentum. Providus his parens Et farra semper tradidit optima, Mites & uvas: atque vini Nectareos melioris haustus.

Sed quæ gens Superi iura patris debuerat sequi Excussit saturo ventre ingum[?], lautius & cute Curata dominum calce petens pinguior effero Illius renuit legitimis nutibus obsequi: Fastoremque procul stulta suum turpiter expulit, Et rupem impetiit ludibriis usque procacibus, Cui fundata Salus Abramidum tempore nititur Cuncto. Nonne Deos postposito perfida Numine Veraci venerans fictitios ritibus impiis Irritare Patrem Coelituum gestiit[?] ut virum Quæ spernit mulier? Quæ nitidos quærit adulteros? Placauit pecudum Tartareos sanguine damonas: Infamesque Deos artificis dextera quos fabri Formarat facilis: quos atauí[?] nescierant, novos, Obscuros, vetitis excoluit religionibus. Rupem oblita suam progenies respuit insolens Cui subnixa fuit certa salus semper sacidum[?]:

page.notes: Printed brace-like bracket at the left of the first verse block, not transcribed. Several words in the second block are blurred: "ingum", "gestiit", "atauí" and "sacidum" are doubtful. The initial S is a decorative drop cap and is joined to "Sed". Show-through from the reverse is visible along the right edge and is omitted.
